title: FedEx believes $300M electric truck spend will save them $800M in diesel
content: In a record-setting commercial truck deal, international shipping giant FedEx has placed an order for 2,000 all-electric box trucks from American startup Harbinger in a deal that’s reportedly worth more than $300 million – but the ROI could be much higher.

title: Watt’s up, doc? Huddig hybrid loader gets a big battery boost [video]
content: Swedish heavy equipment brand HUDDIG has given its 1370 hybrid wheel loader platform a major battery upgrade for the new model year, boosting its battery capacity from 44 kWh to fully 61 kWh – an impressive, 40% upgrade!

title: Brazil hits 56 GW of connection headroom for battery auctions
content:
Brazil’s available grid capacity for battery storage projects exceeds the association’s estimate of 2028-30 power needs by up to 12.5 times, according to an analysis of transmission data.
